name: flashbang
description: The sub-1ms local first duck-duck-go style bang redirects

scripts.build:sw: bun build src/sw/sw.ts --outdir dist --entry-naming sw.js --minify --target browser --format esm
scripts.profile:private: DIST_DIR=dist-e2e ALLOW_UNSAFE_CUSTOM_SUGGEST_URLS=true bun run build && PROFILE_PRIVATE_REDIRECT=true DIST_DIR=dist-e2e ALLOW_UNSAFE_CUSTOM_SUGGEST_URLS=true bunx playwright test tests/e2e/private-perf.e2e.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:e2e: DIST_DIR=dist-e2e ALLOW_UNSAFE_CUSTOM_SUGGEST_URLS=true bun run build && DIST_DIR=dist-e2e ALLOW_UNSAFE_CUSTOM_SUGGEST_URLS=true bunx playwright test --workers=1
